openings.claim: An unresolved row correspondence might leave a batch quantity invariant across every evidence-supported interpretation.
openings.delta: Attack dependence on resolving replacement identity before deciding quantity. Replace single active-row selection with a spreadsheet or script possibility ledger: retain every row, original unit, supplied conversion, status, cutoff and explicit supersession. For ambiguous correspondence, carry alternative interpretations without asserting identity from equal quantities. The nearest rival is the incumbent explicit-link ledger, which leaves missing identity unresolved.
openings.prediction: If supplied records constrain every admissible interpretation to the same quantity, quantity can be reconciled while identity remains unresolved. Otherwise report the recorded alternatives and bounded disagreement. Compared with the incumbent, a differing observation would be more supported resolutions without additional unsupported definite claims. Such invariant batches may not exist.
openings.probe: On both supplied copies, freeze this variant and the incumbent before opening the sealed key. Each review must finish within sixty minutes, produce twelve cited decisions, retain duplicate and unmatched rows, and issue at most three requests naming missing fields or records. Use the extra twenty minutes only for comparison. Compare resolved batches, unsupported definite claims and requests; audit completeness of interpretations. Defeat occurs if omitted interpretations create false invariance, ambiguity cannot be bounded from records, or computation prevents timely decisions. A time cap alone supplies no informative result.
assumptions: Only the supplied conversion and dictionary authorize interpretation; undefined status remains unknown. No neighboring quantity supplies missing data.

Complete possibility coverage and manageable branch count are unproven. If coverage cannot be established, retain disagreement, identify unknown extent and request linkage or status evidence within the three-request limit.

assessment: Synthetic probe proposal, not deployment or measured improvement. Invariance requires evidence-complete interpretations; resource feasibility remains uncertain.

lineage.reason: Preserve provenance and constraints; replace mandatory identity resolution with an invariant-quantity hypothesis.

attacks.dependency: Exact replacement identity must precede a definite batch quantity.
